overview_description.description: Guardian AI is a UAE-based insurtech and AI-powered telematics platform that rewards safe driving behaviour through insurance cashback, driving analytics, and real-time coaching. The company develops a smartphone-based driving companion app that monitors user driving patterns using AI and mobile sensors to generate safety scores and personalised feedback.
